evidence.quote: Despite crosscurrents, the economy is showing continued growth, strong job creation, and rising wages, all in a context of muted inflation pressures.
At the same time, the level of debt certainly could stress borrowers if the economy weakens.
Overall, vulnerabilities to financial stability from business debt and other factors do not appear elevated.

I will focus on the implications of the increase in business debt over the past decade and review the steps the Federal Reserve and other agencies are taking to understand and limit the associated risks.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses financial stability and supervision of business debt, not the monetary policy path, apart from brief notes of strong growth and muted inflation. It takes no clear policy view, so the overall stance is neutral.
